visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of feature tiles (metric/number paragraph, H3 title, description); image cell may be left empty
notes: Repeating structure of six feature tiles. No images: image cell left empty. Metric values (585 km, Over 2,000 kg) and numbers (03-06) are paragraphs, not headings; H3 is the feature title.

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile (6 on source); cell 1 = image (optional, may be empty), cell 2 = metric/number paragraph, H3 title, description

usage: Grid of feature tiles (metric/number paragraph, H3 title, description); image cell may be left empty.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for text-led feature/highlight tiles; add images in the image cell when available.

blockStructure.notes: One row per card; empty image cell must still be included.
